highlights: Harvest by voice: you can leave off count and grams. Suyo Long, 2, 165, next, whether in pieces or in one breath, saves 2 count and 165 grams. Before, the second number replaced the first.
The saved line now says which unit was guessed. A number the app cannot place, or one that could be part of a plant's name, is left out with a note instead of guessed.
Fixed: saying next again right after a refused next could show saved once without saving anything.
